name: inv-consent
purpose: Versioned consent choice and date

name: sb-*-auth-token
purpose: Supabase login/refresh session
duration: Provider-managed session; until sign-out or session expiry; verify configuration

name: inv-watch, inv-lists
purpose: Requested asset/country watchlists and dashboard lists
duration: Until cleared or removed; account copies follow account retention

name: inv-follow, inv-follow-topics, inv-follow-items
purpose: Requested globe/article follows and topics

name: inv-auth-seen, inv-pop, inv-guest, inv-had-account
purpose: Remember account/guest choice and dismissed prompts
category: Strictly necessary to respect those choices

name: inv-app-x
purpose: Remember dismissal of install prompt

name: inv-news-optin, inv-sub
purpose: Newsletter choice / local form acknowledgement
category: Strictly necessary to record requested choice
duration: No coded expiry; inv-news-optin resets after account update

name: inv-owner
purpose: Suppress operator usage events

name: inv-wb (sessionStorage)
purpose: Welcome-back prompt once per browser session

name: inv-theme, inv-pal, inv-studio
purpose: Theme, chart palette and studio appearance
duration: No coded expiry; cleared on rejecting/withdrawing Preferences

name: inv-profile, inv-notif-read
purpose: Legacy local display profile and notification-read count
duration: No coded expiry; cleared on rejecting/withdrawing Preferences

name: inv-learn
purpose: Learning progress
duration: No coded expiry; cleared on rejecting/withdrawing Preferences

name: inv-* (Cache Storage, not a cookie)
purpose: Versioned first-party offline app files and saved responses
category: Strictly necessary for requested offline app
duration: Older versions removed on service-worker activation; browser may evict

name: Usage events (no separate analytics storage key)
purpose: Optional page/interaction statistics sent to Supabase

name: inv-notif-ids, inv-calendar-filters
purpose: Read article IDs and requested calendar filters
duration: Until cleared; read IDs capped at 1000

name: googtrans
purpose: Language selected for Google Translate
duration: Managed by Google; removed by “Show original English”

name: inv-globe-layout
purpose: Where you moved and pinned the Sector overview card on the Globe page

name: inv-reading
purpose: Articles you saved to your reading list on the Globe page (this device only)

name: inv-news-presets
purpose: Saved news filter views on the Globe page (this device only)

name: inv-proj-watch
purpose: Projects you chose to watch in the Projects preview (this device only)

name: inv-alert-follows
purpose: A copy of the smart alerts you follow, so buttons show the right state (your account holds the real list)
duration: Until cleared or you log out
